payload.entry: LANDING AUDIT (2026-11-25): Read all three child beads and every note, the child plan and original Mac phase. Reviewed Mac commits c8692ed3, 7b1fcc05, 1dea9a71, b693bf56, 36b3e4aa, 3b443fe6, 284417d7 and CLI bcf0566b plus current source/fixtures. Existing wire transport pins the event/hash/options, preserves configured status, decodes exit-2 choices, separates filed/queued, and keeps backend ownership; Meetings kind/Command-6 preserves existing scopes. No memory or private-vault work was introduced, honoring no/no memory decisions; first-use scaffolding=rehang and recap_scope=full remain upstream. Independently fetched CI snapshot 3f4fcf361976aac2f1c69c168564bc94f40697b4: its tree exactly matches Mac HEAD 284417d7 (tree 4263a2ce0ef40a450eefa9e67ae2f6b613ee520b). GitHub run 45580348007 reports all required macOS steps success. Prior compile/menu failures are repaired. No unrelated commits landed in bob-cli or Mac between this epic start/first commit and current master; both checkouts equal fetched origin/master. epic-symbols for pw.8.1 and pw.8 returns no entries. Closure is blocked by native integration gaps, detailed in the remaining-work tale: Change meeting never opens the chooser; same-day rows share ForEach path IDs; completed x/DONE agenda rows are incorrectly suppressed; parent/replacement Return and Escape do not follow visible state; native leave/reconfiguration can hide or lose in-flight receipts; entry gating covers only the status menu; refresh callbacks hit agenda twice and omit explicit Refs invalidation; transcript presentation reads shape rather than transcript. Native model/controller/visual acceptance coverage is missing. These are epic work, not external follow-ups.

FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE COMPLETE: pw.8.1.1 #1 proposes protocol and plugin API budgets; pw.8.1.2 #1 proposes plugin API and navigation budgets; pw.8.1.3 #1 combines protocol, keyboard, plugin API, navigation. Used sase_new_task, all-status searches, last-week task sweep, active-epic scope/history review. Canonical count_words disproves the reported clean-base Mac counts: 7d369ae8 protocol=5997 and keyboard=5978; HEAD 284417d7 protocol=6308 and keyboard=6019. Both regressions are caused by this epic and remain in its repair tale; corroborated existing h9 and jz without outsourcing repair. At plugins c1819664, unchanged plugin-apis=9287/8000 and navigation=6029/6000: corroborated ob (advisory develop-page headroom) and jz (fatal reference-page cap). Declined new duplicate tasks; declined a separate CI failure for plugin-apis because that budget is only a warning. No causally related currently-active epic owns a new plugin-source increment in this report. Earlier Refs assertion is already fixed by Mac 36b3e4aa and the matching-tree green CI, so it is not remaining epic work. No other PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries exist.

Original implementation audit (2026-11-25): children 8.1.1–8.1.3 closed; Mac HEAD 284417d7 plus CLI bcf0566b already had guarded JSON transport (event/hash/options pin, configured status, exit-2 choices, filed vs queued, backend ownership) and Meetings kind/Command-6. No memory edits or first-use vault ops. Prior compile/menu failures repaired. Closure was blocked on native integration gaps recorded in the remaining-work tale.

Repaired native flows in the uncommitted Mac overlay: Change meeting waits for previewReady plus the three-row list then showChooser; chooser ForEach uses distinct row identity and skips tokenless rows (list-same-path.json). Write ownership stays on the session (leave/reconfigure cannot hide an in-flight write). Agenda Notes shows completed x/DONE rows and suppresses cancelled. Parent/replace Return and Escape follow visible state. Capability gating hides Command-M, status-menu File Meeting Notes, and agenda Notes when ref meet is unsupported. Preview presents transcript fields from the report. MeetingNotesDesignTests cover preview/chooser/parent/replace/filed/queued at 720/480 aqua+darkAqua. Item-start double-dot rewrite asserts asks.count >= 1. RefsStores cap tests seed one codec write of 2004 rows then one public append/apply so prune still runs without 2005 fsyncs.

Integration review: Command-M, status menu, and agenda Notes enter one sheet; capture draft and first responder restore; Event Note remains distinct; auto-match and agenda preselection both reach guarded filing; clipboard replacement re-previews; queued receipts never offer Open note.
